The SQLite deliverable library and its documentation are dedicated to the
public domain by their authors. The authors permit copying, modification,
publication, compilation, sale, use, and distribution for any purpose.
SQLite does not require a license. This notice records the upstream status;
it does not replace the public-domain dedication in the original source.

AI-BS compiles the official sqlite3.c amalgamation as a static library and
does not distribute SQLite's optional command shell or autoconf scripts.
The upstream sqlite3.c source retains its original public-domain dedication.
